items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Howard Davis. You know Howard Davis?

ctx.x: Yeah, I knew him right now, Louis Dumaine. Now, this is Josh Johnson. Son Johnson we ought to call him. Yeah. And this, that, this is another Johnson, what's the, call his name, I can't think of his name. It's Eddie Johnson. Eddie Johnson, that's right. Oh yeah. Howard Davis. You know Howard Davis?
Yes, I don't know him very well. Yeah.
